summary: Rates page (browser; curl 406) and Firefly re-read: $50 pull-throughs/back-ins, $70 premium, weekly/monthly offered; Firefly shows 10 of 20 units bookable at $50/$70 on Jan and Jun 2027 weeknights (the same 10 taken both times). Booking is online on Firefly as well as by phone (platform phone -> operator). Sites 21, max 75 ft. Google 4.9 from 180. At the $50 line exactly - passes.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): cheapest RV night $50.00 (70' pull-thrus and 75' back-ins), Firefly Jan 12-14 and Jun 8-10 2027 and the rates page, read 2026-11-24 - at, not over, the $50 line; weekly $175 and monthly $550 are cheaper still. gateways.py: none within 40 km. No Good Sam discount on record. GOOGLE 4.9 from 180 reviews.

LONG-STAY (weekly/monthly marketed, ONGOING monthly reservation type): (1) the operator leads with 'a weekend getaway or an extended stay' for RV enthusiasts; (2) nightly rate posted ($50) and bookable online; (3) site reviews describe short trail-riding stays ('when we went to ride some single track at Doe Mountain'); (4) occupancy check: 10 of 20 Firefly units bookable nightly on both Jan 12-14 and Jun 8-10 2027, with the same 10 (1, 8, 11, 13-18) taken both times - probably monthly/ongoing guests, so about half the park is long-stay; (5) no home sales or residents' rules beyond a 30-day notice for monthly stays. Passes; not mostly seasonal.

OHV ANGLE: the operator markets adjacency to Doe Mountain Recreation Area (ATV, hiking, MTB single track), but it is a general full-hookup RV campground, not an OHV staging/trail-base camp; no riding from the sites is mentioned. Flagged only for the reviewer's awareness.
